subject: [PATCH 3/8] selftests/mm: check MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT range handling

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted a patch series to add tests for MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT range handling in madvise(2).

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted a fixup patch to address an issue with sched_getcpu() returning CPU numbers above 1024 on large systems.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch series adds tests for the MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT range handling in the madvise(2) system call. The tests check various edge cases, including zero-length ranges, unaligned starts, and unmapped gaps within the range. The patches also include a fixup to address an issue with sched_getcpu() returning CPU numbers above 1024 on large systems.
